text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 Januari 2014.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2

yang bermula dari kilometer 295.696 (di koordinat U -69250.940, T 45040.613 Grid

Cassini Negeri Terengganu) dan berakhir di kilometer 433.977 (di koordinat

U 44230.307, T 12659.989 Grid Cassini Negeri Terengganu), kedua-dua jarak diukur

dari Pejabat Pos Besar Kuala Lumpur melalui Lebuh Raya Kuala Lumpur–Karak, Lebuh

Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 1 dan Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2 termasuklah

Persimpangan Bertingkat Kijal, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kertih, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Paka, Persimpangan Bertingkat Dungun, Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit

Besi, Persimpangan Bertingkat Ajil, Persimpangan Jalan Telemung, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Telemung, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala Terengganu dan jalan-jalan

sambungannya iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 138.281 kilometer, diisytiharkan sebagai

jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2) 2012

[P.U. (A) 117/2012] dibatalkan.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR–FASA 2

Dibuat 2 Januari 2014

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/3/2 (29); PN(PU2)391/XXVI]

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

 Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat di bawah seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY–PHASE 2) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Terengganu,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (East Coast Expressway–

Phase 2) Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 3 January 2014.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway-Phase 2

commencing from kilometre 295.696 (at coordinates N -69250.940, E 45040.613 of the

Terengganu State Cassini Grid) and ending at kilometre 433.977 (at coordinates

N 44230.307, E 12659.989 of the Terengganu State Cassini Grid), both distances

measured from General Post Office Kuala Lumpur via Kuala Lumpur–Karak Highway,

East Coast Expressway–Phase 1 and East Coast Expressway–Phase 2 including Kijal

Interchange, Kertih Interchange, Paka Interchange, Dungun Interchange, Bukit Besi

Interchange, Ajil Interchange, Telemung Road Junction, Telemung Interchange, Kuala

Terengganu Interchange and its link roads being a distance of 138.281 kilometres, is

declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (East Coast Expressway–Phase 2) Order 2012

[P.U. (A) 117/2012] is revoked.

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]

 Minister of Works
